column6: self+0xbe8: the window-mode bits; the low nibble goes to window_mode_to_ati_format (and 1 << nibble is formatBit), bits 16-22 select the multisample layout
the surface word at +0xc18 whose bit n says buffer record n needs (re)shaping (flags>>bufferId & 1; masked with 0x23f / 0x7ffc03)
the buffer height at +0xbd6 rounded up to a multiple of 32
overlay bottom - top (0x240 when zero), rounded up to a multiple of 16
entries[0].header of the panel as an address: batchWords = batchHeader + 0x20, and the blit-state packet fields are stored at batchHeader + 0x250..0x2f4
0: no state packet was written, so the next packet goes at batchWords[0]; stored at header+0x18
the same header address, while the 0x2f4-byte blit-state packet is copied in and patched
iVar28 + 4: the dword index after the 0x1393 trailer, stored at header+0x18 and used as the index of the following packets (batchWords[batchIndex + k])
the pitch field (+0x16c) of the panel buffer record, multiplied by the row index in the texture-offset word blitPacket[0x9a]
the running end index of the batch: after the state packet (stored at header+0x18) and, when the panel is active, after the last packet written; stored at header+0x14 on both paths
format byte self[0xe2] * 0x1c: the byte offset of its entry in ati_format_info_table, passed to FormatTableLookup_0x0004d2e0
iVar26 * 4 + 0x30 >> 2: the dword index after the 12-dword rectangle packet, where the 0x1393 trailer is written
this+0xd50, the accelerator: its +0x9b0, +0x894, +0x898, +0x89c, +0xb10 and +0xb74 fields are read
the dword index in batchWords at which the 0x31080 rectangle packet is written (batchWords[rectPacketIndex + k])
